parameters.help_en: The unique chatbot identifier (chatbot ID). Log on to the Chatbot console and navigate to Chatbot Details > Session Interface to view the chatbot instance information and obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 机器人唯一标识（机器人ID）。登录云小蜜控制台，机器人详情->会话接口，查看机器人实例信息，可获得该实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The input from the chatbot visitor
parameters.name: utterance

parameters.help_en: The session ID, which identifies a visitor's session and maintains context information. For a new visitor, you do not need to pass this field when calling the Chat operation for the first time. The chatbot starts a session and returns the SessionId in the response of the Chat operation. For subsequent conversation turns of the visitor, pass the SessionId of the current session when calling the Chat operation so that the chatbot can continue the conversation based on the SessionId. Maximum length: 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 会话ID，用于标识一个访问者的会话和保持上下文信息。对于一个新的访问者，首次调用Chat接口时无需传递此字段，机器人会开启一个会话，并在Chat接口的响应中返回该会话的SessionId。对于该访问者的后续轮次的会话，调用Chat接口时传递当前会话的SessionId，机器人即可基于SessionId继续该轮次会话。长度限制是64个字符
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of a knowledge title in the knowledge base. If this ID is specified, the chatbot directly returns the answer for the specified knowledge title
parameters.help_zh: 知识库中知识标题的ID。若指定此ID，那么机器人会直接返回指定知识标题的答案
parameters.name: knowledge_id

parameters.help_en: The visitor ID, which identifies the user in the current session
parameters.help_zh: 访问者ID。用于识别当前会话中的用户
parameters.name: sender_id

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the visitor in the current session
parameters.help_zh: 当前会话中访问的昵称
parameters.name: sender_nick

parameters.help_en: The intent name in the dialog flow. If this name is specified, the chatbot directly enters this intent for Q&A
parameters.help_zh: 对话流中意图名称。 若指定此名称，机器人会直接进入此意图做问答
parameters.name: intent_name

parameters.help_en: The array of perspective codes, which is used to call answers from different perspectives under the same knowledge title. Example: Perspective=["FZJBY3raWr"]. When using the SDK, use the parameters defined in the SDK
parameters.help_zh: 视角编码数组，用于调用同一知识标题下不同视角的答案。如：Perspective=["FZJBY3raWr"]。使用SDK时以SDK中定义的参数为准
parameters.name: perspective

parameters.help_en: A JSON-formatted set of user-defined parameters that can be passed to various dialog engines
parameters.help_zh: 是一个JSON格式的用户自定义参数集，可以传入用户自定义的参数到各对话引擎
parameters.name: vendor_param

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the test or production environment. Default value: false (production environment). Valid values:
true: Test environment. This is for testing only. Using it in production may cause instability and QPS throttling.
false: Production environment
parameters.help_zh:
测试、正式环境标识，默认为正式环境。
true：测试环境，仅限测试使用，生产使用有不稳定、QPS限制等风险。
false：正式环境
parameters.name: sand_box

parameters.help_en: The business space key. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. Obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
